sources.title: HuggingChat - Chat with AI models
sources.snippet: Welcome to HuggingChat, the chat app powered by open source AI models. Omni automatically picks the best AI model to give you optimal answers depending on your requests. You can also choose from any available open source models to chat with directly.

sources.title: Content Management (Shifu Models) | ai-shifu/ai-shifu | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document describes the data models and content structure used to organize and store learning content in AI-Shifu. It covers the database schema for Shifu courses and OutlineItems, the hierarchical content organization, versioning system, and how content flows between the frontend and backend.
